title: Quantifying the 2027 Solvency II Risk Margin Reform
abstract: arXiv:2609.15741v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The 2027 Solvency II reform recalibrates the Risk Margin by reducing the prescribed cost-of-capital rate from 6% to 4.75% and introducing a time-dependent attenuation of future Solvency Capital Requirements. This paper develops an analytical and numerical framework for characterizing the effect of the final regulatory calibration. By normalizing discounted projected capital requirements into a probability distribution over run-off time, we obtain an exact representation of the ratio between the revised and previous Risk Margins. The framework yields sharp universal and horizon-specific bounds, characterizes the effect of later capital timing through stochastic dominance, and shows that mean run-off time alone does not determine the reform effect when temporal dispersion varies. Additional bounds are derived conditional on mean run-off time and horizon. Conditional on a given projected SCR path, the mechanical reduction lies between 20.83

translated_title: 量化2027年偿付能力II（Solvency II）风险边际改革
translated_abstract: 2027年偿付能力II改革通过将规定的资本成本率从6%降至4.75%，并引入对未来偿付能力资本要求（SCR）的时间衰减机制，对风险边际进行了重新校准。本文开发了一个分析与数值相结合的框架，用于刻画这一最终监管校准的影响。通过将贴现后的预测资本要求归一化为关于清算时间的概率分布，我们获得了修订后与修订前风险边际之比的精确表示。该框架给出了精确的通用界限和特定期限界限，通过随机占优刻画了较晚资本时点的影响，并表明当时间分散度发生变化时，仅凭平均清算时间无法决定改革效果。此外，还推导了以平均清算时间和期限为条件的额外界限。在给定预测SCR路径的条件下，机械性降幅位于20.83（摘要在此处不完整）。
tldr: 本文通过将贴现后的预测资本要求归一化为清算时间上的概率分布，开发了一个解析与数值框架，精确刻画了2027年偿付能力II改革（资本成本率从6%降至4.75%并引入时间衰减）下新旧风险边际之比的精确表示及一系列界限。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an analytical and numerical framework—based on normalizing discounted projected capital requirements into a run-off time distribution—that exactly characterizes the ratio between revised and previous Risk Margins under the 2027 Solvency II reform, yielding sharp universal, horizon-specific, and conditional bounds.
